headline: Sensex and Nifty Snap Losing Streak as Value Buying and Positive Global Cues Lift Markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian markets snapped a four-day losing streak on Monday, driven by value buying at lower levels.
Positive sentiment from US markets, where the S&P 500 and Nasdaq ended higher, provided a favorable global backdrop.
Strong corporate performance, specifically Sunteck Realty reporting a 20% rise in net profit for H1FY27.
Optimism surrounding the Anthropic IPO filing in the US revived interest in AI-related sectors globally.
whatHappening: The Sensex closed 480 points higher on Monday, while the Nifty 50 reclaimed the 22,700 level.
JSW Steel and BSE shares emerged as top gainers, rising 5% and 4% respectively during the previous session.
Sunteck Realty reported a 19% growth in pre-sales for the first half of the financial year 2027.
Analysts are providing fresh recommendations on several stocks including Zydus Lifesciences, BEL, and Shriram Finance ahead of today's trade.
summary: Indian benchmark indices ended their four-session losing run on Monday, with the Sensex gaining 480 points to close above 22,700. The recovery was supported by value buying in heavyweights like JSW Steel and positive earnings news from Sunteck Realty. Global optimism following AI-related developments in the US markets is expected to influence early trade today.
